The smell quickly turns sour as it dries, almost like vinegar? And afterwards your skin dries and becomes patchy.   The mask does a poor job of getting rid of any blackheads; it either clogs your pores, or pulls away the invisible baby hairs on your face. claims.text: Most reviewers say the mask does not remove blackheads or work as advertised.
Several reviewers report the mask is too liquidy, doesn't adhere well, or takes a long time to dry.
Some reviewers note the mask leaves skin soft, though this is often the only positive.
A few reviewers complain about the smell turning sour or the product resembling glue.
One reviewer was happy with the product and fast delivery, though noted it hurts a little.
